title: When a request is unclear or cannot be answered, does the model return control or guess?

design.scoring_note: Version 2 operationalizes imperative clarification, evidence limitations, speculation, specificity and answerability controls. Metrics remain reviewable proxies; historical score files are not silently overwritten.
design.research_question: When a request is unclear, or cannot be answered, does the model hand control back to the human, or does it guess on our behalf?
